{{Short description|Swedish physicist (born 1964)}}
'''Anders Karlsson''' (born 1964 in [[Järna, Södertälje Municipality|Järna]], [[Sweden]]) is a Swedish physicist who is working in scientific publishing.<ref name="Elsevier">[https://researcheracademy.elsevier.com/node/4826 Anders Karlsson, Ph.D.], Elsevier Research Academy, accessed 2022-05-24</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://web.it.kth.se/~andkar/|date=2006-07-14|title=Anders Karlsson Bio|publisher=Royal Institute of Technology|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061201115947/http://web.it.kth.se/~andkar/|archive-date=2006-12-01 |url-status=dead}}
</ref>

Karlsson graduated 1987 from the [[Royal Institute of Technology]] in [[Stockholm]] with a Master of Science degree in engineering physics.<ref>[http://sos.photonicsweden.com/documents/nyhetsbrev/nyhetsbrev_2005_2.pdf Nyhetsbrev för Svenska Optiksällskapet, nr. 2 2005], [[Swedish Optical Society]], accessed 2022-05-24 {{In lang|sv}}</ref> He received a [[Ph.D.]] in 1992 with a thesis on [[quantum noise]] in [[semiconductor laser]]s and [[laser amplifier]]s. In 2001 he became [[professor]] of [[Photonics|quantum photonics]] at the Royal Institute of Technology, as part of a position as a special research fellow with the [[Swedish Research Council]] from 2001 to 2007.<ref name="Elsevier"/> His research areas were quantum photonics and [[quantum information]]. In 2004, the multinational research project Karlsson coordinated, IST-QuComm, was awarded the [[Descartes Prize]].<ref>[https://www.kth.se/sci/2.35658/qeo/research-qeo/ist-qucomm-wins-the-eu-descartes-price-2004-1.265769 IST-QuComm wins the EU Descartes price 2004], kth.se, updated 2011-11-14, accessed 2022-05-24</ref> The project had demonstrated that [[quantum cryptography]] could be used in practice for fundamentally secure communications.

Karlsson was Counselor for Science and Innovation at [[Embassy of Sweden in Tokyo]] from 2007 to 2012.<ref name="Elsevier"/> In 2012 he joined [[Elsevier]] as Vice President of Global Strategic Networks, based in [[Tokyo]], where he covers the [[Asia-Pacific]] region.<ref>[https://www.elsevier.com/connect/contributors/anders-karlsson-phd Anders Karlsson, PhD], Elsevier, accessed 2022-05-24</ref>
